releaseNotes: Local models via Ollama, agent sessions with resume, graduated tool permissions and pre/post tool-use hooks, vision-based page checks, and a new schedules view.
macInstallNote: The macOS build is not yet notarized. On first launch, right-click Woodbury in Applications and choose Open, then confirm.
windowsNote: The Windows installer is not available for this release. macOS (Apple Silicon) only for now.
